I hold license, income 20-60. I'm president (influence 2, tie order favors me vs 0's influence 2? holder is 1). Want influence for the 5% commission bonus and presidency. Bribe 5M gives +1 influence → 3, but costs cash. Round 5 action; round 6 remain. Influence matters: president role + max influence commission.

Cash 20.5M, promissory 38.75M (will be cash in round 6 after devaluation... actually start round 6: cash=floor(cash/100)*62 then promissory added. So cash devalues 62%! Wait, cash devalues each round start? "Начало раунда 2 и далее: cash=floor(cash/100)*62, then promissory added". So holding cash loses 38%. Deval applies to cash only, promissory added after. So spending cash now is fine—cash will shrink anyway. So bribing away cash loses little (only 62% kept otherwise). Bribe 20M → influence 6, keeps 568k. Compare keep cash 20.5M→devalued to 12.75M. Bribe 20M keeps 568k+promissory 38.75M. Difference ~12M cost for +4 influence.

Rank is by cash+hard at end. Promissory 38.75M is added to cash in round 6 (no further deval since it's added after deval, end of game after round 6). So my end cash ≈ 568k + 38.75M + round6 sales. Rivals ~10.5M and ~20M → after deval 6.5M and 12.4M. I'm clearly #1. Influence max gives extra 5% of bank (~3.1M) and presidency for veto. Bribing 20M to influence 6 also secures presidency both rounds... round 5 law already? We're in action round 5; influence determines president at law entry.

Cost of bribe 20M vs 5M: each 5M gives +1 influence. Marginal value: max influence bonus ~3.1M and presidential control. One bribe 5M → influence 3, beats others' 2. Enough. But cash 5M spent saves nothing (cash devalues anyway, so spending 5M costs only 3.1M final value). Actually spend now avoids devaluation—bribes are good deals. Bribe 10M → influence 4, cost final ~6.2M vs bonus 3.1M + veto control. Bribing 5M is efficient: influence 3.

Also could do produce/shuttle to make goods for round 6 selling. But one action only. Influence 3 already > all. Choose 5M bribe to 0? Bribing to 0 (rival with 10.5M, influence 2) gives them cash; bribing to 2 gives cash to closer rival. Bribe to 0. Choice 4.
